newsitem.title: UK: Hi-techs underpin Japanese stocks in London.
newsitem.headline: Hi-techs underpin Japanese stocks in London.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London were slightly firmer on Thursday as investors continued to seek semi-conductor and hi-technology shares, traders said.
The Nikkei 50 index in London was up 2.15 points at 1,456.71 by 1307 GMT after Tokyo's Nikkei 225 gained 110.7 points to close at 21,461.37.
Investors were seeking Hitachi, NEC, Toshiba and Fujitsu, among other hi-tech stocks.
"The major players are still buying semi-conductors although demand has quietened down. It's been quite tough making trades today," one dealer said.
Dealers said low-level profit-taking had taken the edge off the market but agreed sentiment remained confident, helped by the higher close in Tokyo.
Reaction to weaker-than-expected U.S. durable goods orders was muted but the rise in U.S. Treasury prices was likely to ensure Japanese stocks held the day's modest gains.
Traders reported some interest in banking stocks but said the market was otherwise quiet.
